segment.source: Renders the opening claim with three or four ticked one-line benefits beside or beneath it, each with its own icon, and the action after them. Use it for: comparison landing pages, paid-campaign pages, B2B offers where the reader wants the shortlist before scrolling, tender and grant pages. Prefer 'Hero with Metrics' when the proof is numeric, and 'Split Media Hero' when a screenshot says it faster than three ticked lines.
